curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Trapped on the high seas with ruthless gunmen and no rations, can a frivolous private eye outwit danger before the voyage goes completely off course?
curatedMovie.description: In Wong Jing's 1993 Hong Kong action comedy, a self-indulgent private investigator winds up trapped aboard a luxury cruise liner alongside wealthy socialites, glamorous passengers, scarce food, and ruthless terrorists.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, comedic action with low emotional weight, perfectly built for a high-energy, easygoing group watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Wong Jing delivers a fast, breezy blend of martial-arts action and broad farce, turning a high-stakes cruise hostage crisis into an energetic, lighthearted thrill ride.
